|game_text=Deploy on Luke (even if a captive) or any non-[Episode I] Throne Room; recirculate. Your duel destiny draws are +1. Once per turn, may lose 3 Force to cancel a just drawn battle destiny at same or related locations of either Luke or this Effect.

|notes=The recovered original Players Committee sheet is linked from the [[I'm With You Too (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original 2005)|2005 publication]]. The early slip allows any Throne Room, has no printed once-per-turn or distance limit on the battle destiny cancellation, and grants a separate captive-Luke shuffle. The 17 September 2007 slip excludes Episode I Throne Rooms, limits the cancellation by timing and distance and drops the shuffle. The earlier full card’s just-drawn phrase expresses the same response timing as the original cancel action. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=14 Period rule or ruling].
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards9.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, starwarsccg.org CDN; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153015id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=2 byte-identical publisher archive]) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #10 on 17 September 2007); page 2, slip 10. Slip image and game text from this sheet. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195543/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[I'm With You Too]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon#Cards|Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
